CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

August 27, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: August 13, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the August 13, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  43 East Valley Boulevard, DRB-2024-00048

  •  Request: This is an application for exterior storefront improvements to an existing
  2,670 SF commercial building, including two (2) new single-swing doors facing the
  parking lot and a new storefront entrance facing South Stoneman Avenue.
  •  Applicant: Robert Wang
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

  1
 MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The applicant shall add an illustration / image of the proposed canopy design
  on the plan set.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  2117 El Paseo Street, DRB-2024-00034

  •  Request: This is an application for an 1,839 SF 2-story second unit (Unit #2)
  attached to the rear of an existing 966 SF 1-story residential unit (Unit #1) with two
  (2) attached 2-car garages, and two new front entry porches.
  •  Applicant: Sam Zhou
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The project shall remove exposed rafter, including the rafter graphics, from the
  plan set.
  2. The project shall identify the proposed color and material on the elevation(s)
  and material board sheet.
  3. The project should show all canopies on the existing house to remain.
  4. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 4:  1420 West Valley Boulevard, DRB-2024-00035

  •  Request: This is an application for exterior alterations and the redesign of two (2)
  existing buildings on a single parcel with six (6) new tenant units for a commercial
  center.
  •  Applicant: Rodrigo Reyes

  2
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following conditions of approval:

  1. There shall be no advertisements on the exterior walls. All signage must be
  approved under a uniform sign program, which must be approved under a
  separate Design Review Board application.
  2. A tree removal permit must be obtained for removal of any trees on-site.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. There shall be no advertisements on the exterior walls. All signage must be
  approved under a uniform sign program, which must be approved under a
  separate Design Review Board application.
  2. A tree removal permit must be obtained for removal of any trees on-site.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 5:  1428 South Marengo Avenue & 1658 West Valley Boulevard, DRB-
2024-00039

  •  Request: This is an application for one (1) free-standing walkway canopy that
  connects an existing skilled nursing facility with a future medical building.
  •  Applicant: Bruce Macpherson & Korina Macias
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions:
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:00 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on September 10, 2024.

  3
 MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:00 P.M.
  •  The second was by Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
